{
  "dataset_name": "splice",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "gpt-5.5-pro",
  "schema_version": "1.0.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "acceptor_ag_match_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Normalized match score for an A followed by G at attributes 29-30, the common acceptor-side boundary dinucleotide.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "central_motif",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Gives the linear margin a smooth, compact cue for a key central motif while retaining partial-match information.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.where(attribute_29 == 'A', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(attribute_30 == 'G', 1.0, 0.0)) / 2.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "donor_gt_match_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Normalized match score for a G followed by T at attributes 31-32, the common donor-side boundary dinucleotide.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "central_motif",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a direct continuous signal for a frequent central motif that a linear SVM can weight strongly.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.where(attribute_31 == 'G', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(attribute_32 == 'T', 1.0, 0.0)) / 2.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "central_exact_boundary_pair_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Average of exact AG at attributes 29-30 and exact GT at attributes 31-32, acting as a simple interaction feature around the central boundary.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "central_motif_interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Adds conjunction information that is hard for a purely linear model to recover from separate single-position indicators.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.where((attribute_29 == 'A') & (attribute_30 == 'G'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_31 == 'G') & (attribute_32 == 'T'), 1.0, 0.0)) / 2.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "upstream_polypyrimidine_fraction_20_28",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Fraction of C or T symbols in attributes 20-28, representing the upstream polypyrimidine tract near an acceptor-side boundary.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "flank_composition",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Supplies a smooth C/T-rich tract measure that supports linear separation without many sparse categorical indicators.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.where((attribute_20 == 'C') | (attribute_20 == 'T'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_21 == 'C') | (attribute_21 == 'T'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_22 == 'C') | (attribute_22 == 'T'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_23 == 'C') | (attribute_23 == 'T'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_24 == 'C') | (attribute_24 == 'T'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_25 == 'C') | (attribute_25 == 'T'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_26 == 'C') | (attribute_26 == 'T'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_27 == 'C') | (attribute_27 == 'T'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_28 == 'C') | (attribute_28 == 'T'), 1.0, 0.0)) / 9.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "upstream_branch_a_fraction_18_27",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Fraction of A symbols in attributes 18-27, a broad branch-region indicator upstream of the central dinucleotides.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "flank_composition",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Creates a continuous upstream adenine enrichment measure that can combine linearly with central motif scores.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.where(attribute_18 == 'A', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(attribute_19 == 'A', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(attribute_20 == 'A', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(attribute_21 == 'A', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(attribute_22 == 'A', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(attribute_23 == 'A', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(attribute_24 == 'A', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(attribute_25 == 'A', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(attribute_26 == 'A', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(attribute_27 == 'A', 1.0, 0.0)) / 10.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "donor_sixmer_consensus_score_31_36",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Six-position donor consensus score over attributes 31-36 using G, T, A/G, A, G, T.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "central_motif",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Compresses a short ordered motif into one graded projection well suited for a linear SVM margin.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.where(attribute_31 == 'G', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(attribute_32 == 'T', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_33 == 'A') | (attribute_33 == 'G'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(attribute_34 == 'A', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(attribute_35 == 'G', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(attribute_36 == 'T', 1.0, 0.0)) / 6.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "central_profile_mode_match_fraction_28_36",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Fraction of attributes 28-36 matching the most frequent nucleotide at the same position in the training fold: C, A, G, G, T, G, A, G, T.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "training_fold_profile",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Gives an unsupervised central-profile similarity score that can stabilize linear margins across sparse categorical patterns.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.where(attribute_28 == 'C', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(attribute_29 == 'A', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(attribute_30 == 'G', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(attribute_31 == 'G', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(attribute_32 == 'T', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(attribute_33 == 'G', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(attribute_34 == 'A', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(attribute_35 == 'G', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(attribute_36 == 'T', 1.0, 0.0)) / 9.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "local_gc_skew_21_40",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Difference between GC fraction in attributes 21-30 and GC fraction in attributes 31-40.",
      "value_range": [
        -1.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "flank_composition",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures directional composition shift around the central boundary as a signed linear-friendly feature.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "((np.where((attribute_21 == 'G') | (attribute_21 == 'C'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_22 == 'G') | (attribute_22 == 'C'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_23 == 'G') | (attribute_23 == 'C'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_24 == 'G') | (attribute_24 == 'C'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_25 == 'G') | (attribute_25 == 'C'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_26 == 'G') | (attribute_26 == 'C'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_27 == 'G') | (attribute_27 == 'C'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_28 == 'G') | (attribute_28 == 'C'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_29 == 'G') | (attribute_29 == 'C'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_30 == 'G') | (attribute_30 == 'C'), 1.0, 0.0)) / 10.0) - ((np.where((attribute_31 == 'G') | (attribute_31 == 'C'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_32 == 'G') | (attribute_32 == 'C'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_33 == 'G') | (attribute_33 == 'C'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_34 == 'G') | (attribute_34 == 'C'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_35 == 'G') | (attribute_35 == 'C'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_36 == 'G') | (attribute_36 == 'C'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_37 == 'G') | (attribute_37 == 'C'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_38 == 'G') | (attribute_38 == 'C'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_39 == 'G') | (attribute_39 == 'C'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_40 == 'G') | (attribute_40 == 'C'), 1.0, 0.0)) / 10.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "downstream_purine_fraction_33_40",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Fraction of A or G symbols in attributes 33-40, measuring purine enrichment just downstream of the donor-side dinucleotide.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "flank_composition",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Adds a normalized downstream composition measure that complements exact central motif features.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.where((attribute_33 == 'A') | (attribute_33 == 'G'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_34 == 'A') | (attribute_34 == 'G'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_35 == 'A') | (attribute_35 == 'G'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_36 == 'A') | (attribute_36 == 'G'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_37 == 'A') | (attribute_37 == 'G'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_38 == 'A') | (attribute_38 == 'G'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_39 == 'A') | (attribute_39 == 'G'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_40 == 'A') | (attribute_40 == 'G'), 1.0, 0.0)) / 8.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "ambiguity_prone_non_acgt_fraction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Fraction of the training-fold ambiguity-prone positions with a non-ACGT symbol: attributes 19, 20, 21, 33, 36, 38, 49, 50, and 56.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "sequence_quality",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Flags uncertain sequence symbols with a small normalized penalty-like covariate useful for robust margins.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.where((attribute_19 != 'A') & (attribute_19 != 'C') & (attribute_19 != 'G') & (attribute_19 != 'T'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_20 != 'A') & (attribute_20 != 'C') & (attribute_20 != 'G') & (attribute_20 != 'T'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_21 != 'A') & (attribute_21 != 'C') & (attribute_21 != 'G') & (attribute_21 != 'T'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_33 != 'A') & (attribute_33 != 'C') & (attribute_33 != 'G') & (attribute_33 != 'T'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_36 != 'A') & (attribute_36 != 'C') & (attribute_36 != 'G') & (attribute_36 != 'T'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_38 != 'A') & (attribute_38 != 'C') & (attribute_38 != 'G') & (attribute_38 != 'T'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_49 != 'A') & (attribute_49 != 'C') & (attribute_49 != 'G') & (attribute_49 != 'T'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_50 != 'A') & (attribute_50 != 'C') & (attribute_50 != 'G') & (attribute_50 != 'T'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_56 != 'A') & (attribute_56 != 'C') & (attribute_56 != 'G') & (attribute_56 != 'T'), 1.0, 0.0)) / 9.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "junction_plausibility_judgment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "A 0.0-1.0 expert score based only on the row sequence, rating whether attributes 29-36 form a biologically plausible splice-boundary pattern with coherent central dinucleotides and nearby context.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "semantic_motif",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Adds a compact nonlinear semantic cue that can be combined with deterministic motif scores by a linear SVM.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "sequence_quality_judgment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "A 0.0-1.0 expert score based only on the 60 observed symbols, rewarding clean A/C/G/T sequence context and penalizing ambiguous letters, unusual local repeats, or extreme composition.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "semantic_quality",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a continuous quality covariate that can reduce sensitivity to noisy or atypical sequence rows.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
